title: Stored XSS/Cross Site Scripting/Injection in the attachment servlet in Apache JSPWIKI on all platforms, all previous…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the attachment servlet of Apache JSPWIKI on all platforms and all previous versions. This flaw allows an attacker to upload a malicious HTML file that may be rendered inline in the browser due to insufficient restrictions on rendering versus file download. The issue is fixed in version 3.0.1.
